claim_checks.note_claim: Factual/emotional memory content and operations; emotional reflection after a predefined action count; taste/emotion-driven actions and post-exit interview.
claim_checks.detail: No unsupported numeric reflection threshold stated.

claim_checks.note_claim: Item quality/popularity sources, LLM-generated 18-genre labels and title summaries, bad-genre item pruning, and replaceable collaborative-filtering algorithms.
Profile/data/action controls: 1000 agents, 25 historical profile items, ≥3 profile like threshold, 18 genres, four items per page, max five pages, evaluation likes strictly >3.
claim_checks.detail: Boundary distinction and page cap match source.

claim_checks.note_claim: Preference discrimination alignment around 65% accuracy/75% recall; low ratings underrepresented; social traits improve behavioral believability with diversity overlap caveat.
claim_checks.detail: Approximations and limitations are represented accurately.

claim_checks.note_claim: Strategy metric leaders: LightGCN leads viewing ratio, like ratio and satisfaction; MF leads mean like count and exit page; viewed feedback improves offline/simulated measures and unviewed generally worsens them.
claim_checks.detail: Note correctly qualifies Table 2 as metric-specific and uses generally for unviewed feedback.

claim_checks.note_claim: Four-round filter-bubble results and DirectLiNGAM learned causal graph are simulator-data findings.
claim_checks.detail: Note makes no claim that the fitted graph independently establishes human causal effects.
